$comment: WORKED EXAMPLE (NG-11 §2j) — the shape of the FR jurisdiction rule set, shown unsigned with signature/key fields elided. The production FR-ECO-10060 rule set is authored from the CPG Knowledge Graph's eligibility logic, signed, and hashed at build; this example is never served. Evaluation walk-through: an ECO object with /packaging/epr_registration present, /labeling/fr_language true and no /substances entries matches no RESTRICT or CONDITIONAL rule and falls to rule ALLOW-BASE → CPG-200 ALLOW. An ECO object missing /packaging/epr_registration fires EPR-01 → CPG-300 CONDITIONAL with the registration condition. An ECO object listing a substance in the restricted set fires SUB-01 → CPG-403 RESTRICT.
